# Closed loop with the control board's delay (generated by loop_digital.py)

Delay TD = 60 us sample-to-PWM plus the zero-order hold (Ts / 2 = 16 us), Ts = 32 us (31.25 kSPS per controlled channel). Duty limit 0.97.

Gains chosen by a grid search on variant B (PM >= 45 deg, GM >= 8 dB at every corner, lowest output impedance peak 20 Hz-5 kHz at 700 ohm): **Kp = 2, Ki = 1000 1/s, Kc = 20 ohm** (v_sw in volts per volt of error; Kc in volts per ampere of capacitor current).
